justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/field/FieldDescription.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/field/FieldList.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java. The target has notable fan-in: rg found 23 referencing files total (9 production, 14 test), including Advice.java, JavaConstant.java, MethodCall.java, FieldAccessor.java, DynamicType.java, and several field-related tests. But fan-out is low: ForLoadedField is a thin wrapper around one java.lang.reflect.Field and directly depends only on Field, TypeDescription/TypeDescription.Generic, AnnotationList, and a lazy projection helper. That is broad reuse, but not the high outgoing dependency hub expected for hub-like modularization.
